games.title: Dead Space: Extraction
games.rationale: Slim angular tool-like silhouette keeps the sight area open. A provisional stand-in for the science-fiction setting; selected in-game weapon matching remains open.

games.title: Gunblade NY & L.A. Machineguns: Arcade Hits Pack
games.rationale: The catalog describes mounted machine guns; the built heavy model already has paired rear grips for two-handed aim.

games.title: The House of the Dead: Overkill
games.rationale: Exaggerated chunky toy silhouette gives this arcade rail-shooter its own visual identity; owner choice and weapon matching remain open.

games.title: Link's Crossbow Training
games.rationale: A training-shell proxy with an open sight line and second grip for two-handed target practice. A crossbow silhouette is a separate future design choice; this does not claim weapon matching.

games.title: Resident Evil: The Darkside Chronicles
games.rationale: Compact form with little visual clutter keeps the sight picture clear during camera motion; exact weapon matching awaits review.

games.title: Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles
games.rationale: Readable semi-automatic silhouette and slide; a provisional handgun stand-in, not an assertion about the selected in-game weapon.

games.title: Sin & Punishment: Star Successor
games.rationale: Angular pointer-gun form distinguishes character movement plus pointer aiming; retain the free analog-stick hand.
